name: brestprihodpf
description: Static one-page site of the parish of Sts. Peter and Fevronia of Murom, Brest

scripts.build: npm run build:css && npm run build:vendor-css && npm run build:vendor-js && npm run build:js
scripts.build:vendor-css: node build/vendor-css.mjs build/.vendor-concat.css && cleancss -O1 -o css/vendor.min.css build/.vendor-concat.css
scripts.build:vendor-js: node build/vendor-js.mjs build/.vendor-concat.js && terser build/.vendor-concat.js --compress --mangle --comments "/^!|@license|@preserve/" -o js/vendor.min.js
